name: tokens-large-file
description: mcpp design 2026-10-28 §11.1 (P10): a file of 10000 lines that imports std and three modules of its project (no build system: the semantic kit), opened as an editor opens it, with a completion and its semantic tokens asked for at once; then a line is inserted and the tokens are asked for as a delta of the last answer. Two stages on one cache: cold (nothing kept) and warm (a second server; what the first kept is there). The client declares workspace.semanticTokens.refreshSupport, as VS Code does, and asks for the tokens again on a refresh; it polls only when no refresh comes, and a poll is over budget. The budgets are the design's criteria: on a warm open the compiler's tokens are not later than the first completion; after the edit the server sends the change, not the file (editShare); the inserted line gets the compiler's tokens through a refresh; a range is cut from what is kept (T3). The measures carry the server's own counters (cxxModules/report semanticTokens).
